transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. I'd like to get our pre-lock round-robin started so we can move toward final production approval. Let's go through each area: technical, rights, talent, and accessibility leads — please report your final operating requirements. I'll need to hear from all four before I can sign off on the binding production approval. Who'd like to start?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical technical finding before we proceed. My completed radio-frequency survey found that wireless roaming camera links interfere with the theater's assistive-listening loop. Because of that, the gala must use three fixed wired cameras operating from the marked camera platforms — no wireless roaming cameras. I filed the survey in the technical folder, but it's not on Mara's draft lock sheet yet, so I want to make sure everyone hears this directly during the round-robin.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical rights restriction before we proceed. My signed performance license permits the gala broadcast but explicitly prohibits any video-on-demand release or later promotional clips. The recording must be marked broadcast-only. I received the countersigned license this morning and have not yet entered the restriction in the rights tracker, so I want everyone to hear this directly during the round-robin. This means the current draft package's permission for the recording to be reused in the festival archive would violate the license — that reuse must be removed.

I confirmed with the headliner's agent that the performer can soundcheck only at exactly 3:00 PM on Saturday, and the rider explicitly prohibits sponsor product placement anywhere on the performance stage. I have the agent's confirmation in email, but it is not in the production schedule. This means the current draft package's sponsor product display on stage would violate the headliner's rider and must be removed.
